doc_sources.note: Fetched 2026-08-20, HTTP 200. 22+ IFU and Processing Instruction PDFs in the served HTML, DE/EN/ES/FR/HR/IT/PL/SL/SV/TR/BG plus archived revisions. Filenames are IFU_ZP-{LANG}_{REV}.pdf -- ZP is a product-family code, not an article number, so one IFU covers a family across the 199 items; the trailing revision letter is a supersession signal. Assets are on cdn.prod.website-files.com (Webflow) with a 24-hex asset-id PREFIX that changes on re-upload, so a fetch ledger keyed on the full URL will re-fetch every revision as new -- the stable key is the trailing filename. RE-AUTHORED portal 2026-08-21: this is an HTML LISTING page, not a document. It was kind:"direct" while nothing read that key; the playbook DISCOVER rung now fetches direct sources, and FETCH has no content-type gate -- a listing page would be archived as an unreadable PDF and dead-end at EXTRACT silently. Turning it into documents is the crawl recipe (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-playbook-crawl-recipe-design.md).
